shared._comment_roots: hostWorkspaceRoot=Docker host bind; hermesWorkspaceRoot=Hermes view; defaultWorkerWorkspaceRoot=worker view (/workspaces). Request workspace is relative under that dataset, preferred <project>/issue-<slug>.
shared._comment_images: Optional shared.allowedImages allowlist. Request body image (from worktree .hermes/hermes_config.yaml (else .agents)) is preferred on ensure/run; local-tags-only (never pull). profile.image is fallback.

simple-ng-proj._comment_image: Fallback when request omits image. Per-issue SoT is <worktree>/.hermes/hermes_config.yaml (else .agents) image.
